images.name: Wood
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game material pigment source pack for a low-poly alpine village. Generate one square image containing exactly FOUR equal square material swatches in a strict 2 by 2 grid, full-bleed edge to edge, no borders or gaps. Each quadrant is a flat orthographic texture sample, NO perspective, NO object or scene, NO labels, letters, numbers, logos, symbols, framing or watermark. Restrained hand-painted material character with calm broad structure, enough detail for native-resolution gameplay but not photographic noise. Uniform diffuse pigment only, NO baked light, shadow, highlights or ambient occlusion. Each quadrant should tile on all four of its own edges. Existing objects are old and used, never newly polished, never ruinously dirty. Top left: continuous vertical weathered grey-brown conifer timber grain, restrained age checks, no plank joints. Top right: continuous vertical pale oatmeal pine grain with sparse soft small knots, no plank joints. Bottom left: continuous vertical muted warm oak open grain with soft broad cathedrals, no plank joints. Bottom right: continuous vertical deep desaturated walnut grain, quiet rubbed age, no plank joints. All wood remains dry matte. No large random stains or dramatic black cracks.
